usage.summary: `good-listbox` is an always visible list of items. By default it is an action list: activating an item emits `itemActivated` without changing selection. Set `selectionMode="single"` or `"multiple"` when the list should own selection. Use `good-select` when choices should open from a form field, or `good-dropdown` for commands and navigation. Selection is a set of item IDs; even single selection uses an array with zero or one ID. This keeps the event and Angular Forms value shape consistent when an app switches between single and multiple selection.
